title: 18.12. Hetusahetukaduka, Hetuduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Hetuñceva sahetukaṁ hetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu ceva naahetuko ca nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.
Sahetukañceva na ca hetuṁ nahetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naahetuko ceva nana ca hetu nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.
